title: Awakening Joy
speaker: James Baraz and Shoshana Alexander
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating well-being and ease in our daily lives, rather than just going through the motions or feeling obligated to do so. It suggests that even small, subtle shifts in our approach can lead to significant positive change - for example, being open to new experiences like meditation, which may initially feel unappealing but ultimately bring benefits. The speaker encourages us to be mindful of our own desires and interests, rather than simply following societal norms or expectations. By doing so, we can develop greater self-awareness and kindness towards ourselves, leading to a more authentic and fulfilling life.
topics: gold (as in the concept of renunciation)
